topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 54 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 4 ERC20 tokens, 8 ERC721 NFTs, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 21 common project-authored base contract(s) (onft721enumerable, onft721core, oapp). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
